summary: Method: 42 cells from whitespace_input.json were normalized (duplicate spellings collapsed, 12 analyst 'WHITESPACE' notes removed, government-owned systems separated from vendors, 17 placement corrections). Result: on the 6x7 grid NO cell is empty or sparse (<=2 vendors); the thinnest cells have 10-19 distinct vendors and the densest 53 (PROCESS/theater). The matrix is too coarse to show white space, so every one of the 13 thinnest cells plus TRANSPORT/coalition and TRANSPORT/division_corps (fewest non-prime vendors) and DISSEMINATE_TASK/coalition (carrying an embedded whitespace note) were tested, and the 12 sub-cell whitespaces embedded by segment agents were tested separately. Verdicts across the 16 tested cells: 6 government-only (FUSE and DISSEMINATE_TASK at individual_platform, DECIDE/coalition, TRANSPORT/coalition, DISSEMINATE_TASK at battalion_brigade and division_corps), 3 classification (COLLECT/coalition, PROCESS/coalition, FUSE/joint), 3 economics (DECIDE/individual_platform, COLLECT/division_corps, TRANSPORT/division_corps), 1 artifact (DECIDE/tactical_unit), and 3 under-served: DISSEMINATE_TASK/coalition (born-releasable objects and automated releasability, G01/G30/G12, MEDIUM), DECIDE/battalion_brigade (DDIL-native battalion-and-below orders/planning glue, G18/G06/G34, MEDIUM) and FUSE/coalition (brigade-and-below multinational COP federation, G12, LOW - exercise-documented demand, no RFI). Among sub-cells, the strongest under-served signals with procurement-grade evidence are tactical zero-trust tagged-data enforcement (G02: Navy FY26 SBIR topics) and formation-level PNT integrity/interference aggregation into the C2/EW COP (G04/G11: Army NAVWAR-SA A-CDD and a PM PNT opportunity); the 'only Rune, early' DDIL sustainment note is an artifact (Rune won a $99M IDIQ ceiling in June 2026 and a $4.1M TMI award in Sept 2026), and coalition logistics is government-only (NCIA ESS LOGSUITE procurement, award planned 2026-09-09). Crowding: Anduril appears in 39 of 42 cells and Palantir in 26, and the government TAK ecosystem in 18; the most crowded cells are PROCESS/theater (Palantir, commercial GEOINT, OSINT), PROCESS/tactical_unit and COLLECT/tactical_unit (Anduril, Hidden Level, Cubic, Picogrid, sUAS vendors), PROCESS/joint (Palantir, Booz Allen Advana), TRANSPORT/tactical_unit (Anduril, L3Harris, Persistent, Silvus, Ditto, Starshield) and FUSE/battalion_brigade (Anduril, Palantir, Lockheed NGC2, Northrop IBCS/FAAD C2). Caveats: absence of competitors is not opportunity; IDIQ ceilings cited are not revenue; every under-served coalition cell is gated by Secret-REL/MPE access, which for a non-U.S.-person co-founder needs export-control and facility-clearance counsel before it is treated as addressable.
